name: Darkmoon LLM finding -> OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025) -> MITRE ATLAS crosswalk
status: curated by Darkmoon, NOT an official MITRE or OWASP mapping
owasp_version: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 (CC BY-SA 4.0): only IDs and short titles are used, no description is reproduced

relations.demonstrated: the finding was exploited: the adversary technique was actually performed against the target
relations.enabled: the finding shows a weakness that makes the technique possible; the technique itself was not performed

relation_rule: relation = demonstrated only if the finding status is 'exploited' AND the entry allows it (max_relation); otherwise enabled

sources.owasp-cited: ATLAS ID cited in the OWASP LLM 2025 entry (Related Frameworks and Taxonomies); citation not machine-verifiable (client-rendered page), checked by hand on 2026-11-03
sources.atlas-cited: the ATLAS 2026.10 technique cites this OWASP LLM 2025 entry in its references (verifiable in the vendored YAML)
sources.owasp-cited-renumbered: OWASP 2025 cites an ATLAS ID removed in 2026.10; replaced by its successor listed in lineage
sources.curated: Darkmoon reading of the ATLAS technique description; no citation in either source

lineage._note: IDs removed between ATLAS 2026.09 and 2026.10 (computed by build_frameworks_data.py) and the successor Darkmoon uses. basis: same_name = identical technique name in 2026.10; curated = Darkmoon judgement; none = no successor asserted

atlas.source_note: T0034.001 cites the OWASP 2025 Top 10 document as a whole, not LLM10 specifically
